sources.title: Introducing computer use, a new Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Claude 3.5 Haiku
sources.evidence: October 22, 2024 announcement names Claude 3.5 Haiku, describes low latency, coding, tool use and specialized sub-agent uses, and says public availability was still forthcoming.

sources.title: Claude Platform release notes
sources.evidence: November 4, 2024 entry announces text-only API availability; February 24, 2025 adds vision. February 19, 2026 entry explicitly maps Claude Haiku 3.5 to claude-3-5-haiku-20241022 and records its retirement on the Claude API.

sources.title: Model Card Addendum: Claude 3.5 Haiku and Upgraded Claude 3.5 Sonnet
sources.evidence: Original model-card addendum identifies Haiku 3.5 as a Claude 3-family model and reports tool-use, coding and reasoning evaluations. Its technical text and comparison tables provide no total/active parameter counts or dense/MoE architecture specification.

sources.title: Partner model deprecations — Claude 3.5 Haiku on Google Cloud
sources.evidence: Exact Claude 3.5 Haiku section documents 200,000-token context, text/code/image input, text output, function calling, no extended thinking, and a documents specification pointing to PDF support. Its release-date row says October 22, conflicting with explicit availability announcements; treated as snapshot/announcement date. Retained deprecated-model specifications do not prove current operation.

sources.title: Unsupervised Elicitation of Language Models
sources.evidence: Section 3.3 explicitly classifies Claude 3.5 Haiku and Claude 3 Haiku as proprietary, contrasting them with open-weight Llama models. Experiments largely use pretrained variants; section 4.4 separately discusses the publicly released Claude 3.5 Haiku assistant. This establishes classification, not parameter counts or a named weight license.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Haiku 4.5
sources.evidence: October 2025 successor card explicitly identifies Claude Haiku 3.5 as the previous Haiku model and states it had no extended-thinking mode. Exact-name comparison tables report evaluations, not parameter counts; searched text provides no parameter-count or architecture specification for Haiku 3.5.

sources.title: Announcing Anthropic’s upgraded Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Claude 3.5 Haiku on Vertex AI
sources.evidence: Editor's note explicitly distinguishes October 22 pre-announcement from the November 4, 2024 update confirming Haiku 3.5 availability.

sources.title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet System Card
sources.evidence: Later first-party system card reviewed as an additional disclosure check. It introduces extended thinking for Sonnet 3.7; no total/active parameter count or architecture specification for Haiku 3.5 was found in its parsed text.

sources.title: On the Biology of a Large Language Model
sources.evidence: March 27, 2025 first-party research explicitly studies production Claude 3.5 Haiku. Method Overview says the studied models are Transformer-based, with MLP and attention layers. The 30 million features describe its replacement transcoder, not the production model parameter count; no total/active count or dense/MoE designation is established.

sources.title: Claude Model Pricing — List Prices by Platform, effective May 12, 2026
sources.evidence: Parent reviewed page3: the May12,2026 API pricing table lists 200K and 1M rows for Claude 3.5 Haiku. These rows postdate Anthropic API retirement and conflict with retained exact-model context specifications; no corroborating availability announcement was found.

name.note: Current official naming order; launch materials also use Claude 3.5 Haiku.

developer.note: Developer-authored announcement and card identify Anthropic.

family.note: Normalized catalog family key for Anthropic's Haiku model line; the original card also places it within the broader Claude 3 generation.

release_date.note: Earliest public availability verified by Anthropic's own dated API release entry and Google's availability update. October 22 is the announcement/model snapshot date, despite the conflicting date in Google's later specifications table.

open_weights.note: Anthropic-authored research explicitly distinguishes Claude 3.5 Haiku as proprietary from open-weight Llama models. Paid API access alone is not used as the evidence.

license.note: Descriptive proprietary classification explicitly supported by Anthropic research. The catalog permits this category; it does not imply an SPDX or public weight-distribution license.

parameters_b.note: No supported total parameter count found in the original addendum, later exact-name comparisons in the Haiku 4.5 card, or targeted first-party searches. No sibling size is transferred.

active_parameters_b.note: No active parameter count is separately reported in the reviewed primary sources. Dense architecture is not assumed, and total and active counts are not equated.

architecture.note: The exact-model interpretability study explicitly describes Transformer-based models with MLP and attention layers. Dense/MoE routing and parameter counts remain undisclosed; replacement-transcoder features are not model parameters.

context_window.note: Provider's retained exact-model specifications state 200,000 context length; this is a documented model limit, not a current endpoint-operation test. A later post-retirement pricing table also lists a conflicting 1M API tier; retain 200K from exact-model documentation because the pricing row does not establish feature availability.

modalities.note: Initially text-only; Anthropic added image input on February 24, 2025. Google's exact-model technical table documents images and PDF documents; PDF denotes supported document processing, not a separate learned sensory modality. This records later documented capability.

reasoning.note: False means no dedicated extended-thinking mode. The later Haiku 4.5 card explicitly confirms this for Haiku 3.5; it does not mean the model cannot solve reasoning tasks.

tool_call.note: Anthropic describes improved tool use; the exact-model provider specification lists function calling.

description.value: Claude Haiku model released in November 2024 with a 200K-token context window and tool calling.
description.note: Plain description of verified release, context and tool support.

patch.description: Claude Haiku model released in November 2024 with a 200K-token context window and tool calling.

sources.label: Anthropic API availability and vision release notes
On the Biology of a Large Language Model
Anthropic later pricing table with conflicting context tier

patch.notes: Announced October 22, 2024; Anthropic's release notes confirm public API availability November 4. Image input was added February 24, 2025, so modalities describe later documented capability. No extended-thinking mode. Transformer architecture is documented by Anthropic interpretability research; total/active counts and dense/MoE routing remain undisclosed. Claude API retirement was February 19, 2026; retained capability documentation does not establish current endpoint availability. A May 12, 2026 pricing PDF lists a conflicting 1M API tier after retirement; retained exact-model specifications support 200K.

summary: Confirmed November 4 public release, proprietary classification, 200K context, tools, later image/PDF inputs and no extended thinking. Parent found explicit Transformer architecture in exact-model interpretability research. Total/active counts and dense/MoE routing remain undisclosed.
